messages:
Molly: OK team — massive news: we crossed 77.7M ARR this morning 🎉🥳
Diego: wait WHAT 😳
Ana: no way, congrats!!!! :tada: :confetti_ball:
Seb: rooftop kombucha keg at 4pm? count me in. 🍹
Priya: kombucha keg is very on-brand. can we also do a tiny succulent raffle? 🌱
Tess: also +1 for glitter pins. low effort, high morale. ✨
Molly: love both ideas. kiosk outside kitchen with succulents and pins, 3 tickets per person, winner gets a plant named after them 😉
Diego: can ops-bot schedule the 4pm slack reminder? :eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 16:00 today in #random (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Ana: i'll bring a small cake — coconut? or yuzu? thoughts? 🍰
Priya: coconut please. also a tiny sign: "77.7M — we persisted"
Seb: printing sign now. i'll also bring a tiny kazoo (for moral support) 🎶
Molly: best kazoo award goes to the loudest. also, if anyone needs stickers/mini merch for friends/fam, leave a note at the kiosk.
Diego: i made a quick gif to celebrate (reaction: :party_parrot:)
Tess: posting it in thread. so proud of everyone. quiet flex: engineering team shipped that autoscaler that made a huge diff.
Priya: shoutout to infra + runtime for the late-night patches. we survived the 2am token storm.
Molly: yes. big kudos. small ceremony at 16:15 to shout names. 5 min max.
Ana: i'm making a tiny quiz about weird commit messages — prize is a plant. 
Seb: what if the plant dies? we have a re-gifting policy.
Molly: rules: no plant abandonment. official plant guardian list on the fridge.
Diego: i'll make a tiny playlist for the rooftop: morning beats -> victory ballads -> slow clap.
ops-bot: Congratulations message posted to #company-announcements (reaction: :tada:)
Tess: also, for folks remote — we'll stream from the kitchen + drop a virtual confetti GIF in #all-hands.
Molly: perfect. see y'all at 4pm. bring your best plant puns 🌿
Priya: see you — planting the flag (and a succulent) 🌵
Seb: victory nap scheduled for 16:30.
(END)
